rows.reasoning: The only evidence is HB2853 (2022), the Arizona empowerment scholarship account expansion, which Kavanagh co-sponsored and voted for in the House of Representatives on 06/22/2022, before the Senate term that began 2023-01-02; under V5 a record from an earlier office is valid for that office only, so no passage survives for this seat. On its content the instrument would be chair-shaped for the rung "Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family", because new section 15-2401.01 makes every resident eligible to enroll in a public school a qualified student, but that reading cannot be seated here.
